title: digitalis purpurea subsp. nevadensis
intro: Digitalis purpurea subsp. nevadensis, commonly known as Mountain Foxglove, is a subspecies of the Digitalis purpurea plant, belonging to the Apocynaceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, particularly in traditional medicine, due to its ability to stimulate cardiac function and treat heart conditions such as atrial fibrillation and congestive heart failure. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Foxglove include increasing cardiac contractility and reducing the heart rate, thereby improving the efficiency of the heart. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include glycosides, specifically digoxin and digitoxin, which have been used to treat various cardiovascular disorders.
